name: Tokenized Gold (EGR)
description: A SEBI-style Electronic Gold Receipt tokenized as fungible units (ERC-20) where 1 token = 1 gram of fine gold held in an accredited vault. A vault manager issues receipts against a physical deposit (mint), KYC-verified India-jurisdiction participants trade grams on the DvP marketplace at the digital-rupee gold price (a small exchange fee routes to the platform), and a physical withdrawal surrenders the tokens for delivery (burn) — gated behind maker-checker approval so releasing bullion from the vault needs a second pair of eyes. The vault receipt id is enforced unique so one physical deposit is tokenized only once; the assay certificate stays off-ledger with only its hash on-chain. Freeze places a compliance/lien hold on an account.

receiptId.description: SEBI Electronic Gold Receipt number the vault manager issues against a physical deposit — enforced unique so one deposit is tokenized only once

custodian.description: SEBI-accredited vault manager holding the physical gold (e.g. Sequel, Brink's India)

refiner.description: LBMA / BIS-accredited refiner of the underlying bars

fineWeightGrams.description: Total fine-gold grams backing this issuance (1 token = 1 gram)

barSerial.description: Serial number(s) of the physical bar(s) in the vault

assayCertificateUrl.description: Off-ledger link to the refiner assay / quality certificate (only its hash lives on-ledger)

assayCertificateHash.description: SHA-256 of the assay certificate (pins the off-ledger document)
